$comment: Targeted probe of priority-aware dispatch failure modes.
6 tasks; one shared scenario (line_stress on simbench_lv) to keep
topology fixed across runs; ablation axis sweeps the three suspected
- h2: QP saturation-aware vs current denominator (enable_qp_gossip on/off)
- h3: supply vs demand vs legacy holon ADMM paths
All use uniform priority distribution so every tier (1..10) is populated.
name: priority_dispatch_probe

experiments.name: h2_qp_saturation
experiments.$comment: QP gossip on vs off — current QP dual update divides by sum(a_j) without filtering saturated agents (balance.py:1343-1346). When tier-1 loads saturate at 0 headroom, they should not slow the dual step for free tier-N agents. Compare priority_invariant on a deficit-bearing run.

experiments.name: h1_clamp_tier_blindness
experiments.$comment: constraint_aware on vs off — clamp_to_constraints is priority-blind (util.py:882). Above deadband 0.85 every tier gets cut equally. Run line_stress so loading_percent goes well past 0.85 and check tier-1 served fraction relative to lower tiers.
